ARTILLERY.trigger: An Artillery unit (or Damaged Artillery) loses a land fight and the demotion ladder routes it to the destroy/damage block; specifically intact Artillery taking its first loss.
ARTILLERY.inputs: Loser UnitRecord is type Artillery; combat already decided (attacker won) by the land decider func_05CA7E; consequence applier func_05B2C2 reaches its destroy/damage block.
ARTILLERY.outputs: Intact Artillery is downgraded to Damaged Artillery (not destroyed). Shows 'X Artillery damaged. Further damage will destroy it.'.

ARTILLERY2.trigger: A Damaged Artillery unit loses a land fight (its second loss).
ARTILLERY2.inputs: Loser UnitRecord is type Damaged Artillery; combat decided against it.
ARTILLERY2.outputs: The damaged artillery is destroyed and removed from the board. Shows 'Damaged X Artillery destroyed.'.

DEMOTE.trigger: A combatant land unit loses a fight on open ground (no colony/fort present) and has a defined demotion target on the fixed ladder.
DEMOTE.inputs: Loser UnitRecord type; fixed remap ladder (byte-verified in func_05B2C2): Dragoon->Soldier, Soldier->Free Colonist, Continental Cavalry->Continental Army, Continental Army->Free Colonist, Cavalry->Regular; a veteran-status override (vet_type==24) remaps a 0-outcome to Expert-class 3 instead. Types with no ladder entry are destroyed outright (no DEMOTE message).
DEMOTE.outputs: Loser's unit type is changed to the next-lower rung; the unit survives. Shows 'X Y routed! Unit demoted to Z status.'.

LOOTCAPTURE.trigger: A Treasure unit is captured when an enemy combat unit defeats/overruns its stack (the non-combatant capture path).
LOOTCAPTURE.inputs: Loser is a Treasure-carrying unit (non-combatant type); capturing power; treasure value carried by the unit.
LOOTCAPTURE.outputs: The treasure (worth N gold) is seized by the capturing power. Shows 'X treasure worth {N} CAPTURED by the Y!'.

WAGONCAPTURE.trigger: A Wagon Train unit is captured when an enemy combat unit defeats it (non-combatant capture path).
WAGONCAPTURE.inputs: Loser is a Wagon Train (non-combatant type); capturing power.
WAGONCAPTURE.outputs: The wagon train (and any cargo) is captured by the enemy power. Shows 'X wagon train CAPTURED by the Y!'.

COLONISTCAPTURE.trigger: A defenseless colonist-type unit (Free Colonist / specialist) is captured by an enemy combat unit (non-combatant capture path).
COLONISTCAPTURE.inputs: Loser is a colonist/non-combatant unit; capturing power.
COLONISTCAPTURE.outputs: The colonist(s) are captured by the enemy power. Shows 'X colonists CAPTURED by the Y!'.

COLONISTCAPTURE2.trigger: A Veteran Soldier loses and is captured/reduced, also stripping veteran status (the capture branch that emits the 'lose Veteran status' variant).
COLONISTCAPTURE2.inputs: Loser is a (veteran) soldier whose capture reduces it to colonist; capturing power.
COLONISTCAPTURE2.outputs: The colonist(s) captured AND the soldier loses Veteran status. Shows 'X colonists CAPTURED by the Y! Soldiers lose Veteran status.'.

CARGOCAPTURE.trigger: A ship attacker wins a ship-vs-ship fight and seizes a portion of the loser's cargo (ship-path spoils).
CARGOCAPTURE.inputs: Winning ship; losing ship's cargo (commodity type + tonnage); ship-path roll already resolved in func_05B2C2.
CARGOCAPTURE.outputs: A cargo of N units of a commodity is transferred to the victorious ship. Shows 'X cargo of {N commodity} captured by {Y ship}!'.

SHIPSUNK.trigger: A ship loses a ship-vs-ship fight badly enough to be sunk (ship-path destroy branch). Per the ship roll, the attacking ship wins iff roll<=hull, and a losing defender with no repair option sinks.
SHIPSUNK.inputs: Loser ship type + name; victor ship type + name; ship roll on guns(DEF)/hull(ATK).
SHIPSUNK.outputs: The ship is destroyed (sunk) with all cargo lost. Shows 'X Y sunk by Z W!'.

VALOR.trigger: A soldier-class unit wins a land fight and is promoted up the combat ladder (the generic promotion case in the post-combat FX routine, reached on a combat WIN).
VALOR.inputs: Winning UnitRecord; its current class and next class; called from the land decider's win branch (func_05CA7E -> func_05C69C post-combat FX). Reaches the generic 'promoted from X to Y' branch (the non-Veteran, non-Continental case).
VALOR.outputs: The unit's type advances one promotion rung. Shows 'Because of their valor in battle, our X soldiers have been promoted from Y to Z status.'.

CAPTURED.trigger: An enemy (or, during the revolution, the King's) force successfully captures one of your colonies, plundering its treasury.
CAPTURED.inputs: Attacking power; defending colony; gold in the colony treasury plundered. Resolved in the colony attack/capture path of the land decider func_05CA7E.
CAPTURED.outputs: The colony changes hands and N gold is plundered. Shows 'X march into Z! {N} plundered!'.

CAPTURED2.trigger: Another power's colony is captured by a third party and you learn of it via spies (the spy-report variant of a colony capture, no plunder shown to you).
CAPTURED2.inputs: Attacking power; the foreign colony captured.
CAPTURED2.outputs: Spy report informs you the colony was taken. Shows 'Spies report: X march into Z.'.

CAPTURED3.trigger: A colony you can directly observe is captured, but with no treasury to plunder (the no-plunder variant of a colony capture).
CAPTURED3.inputs: Attacking power; the captured colony (empty/no gold).
CAPTURED3.outputs: The colony changes hands; no gold message. Shows 'X march into Z!'.

HALF.trigger: A unit with too few movement/action points left is ordered to attack this turn anyway; the game warns it will fight at reduced strength and asks for confirmation.
HALF.inputs: Acting unit's remaining action capacity (soft_score < 3 in the leaf); the fraction-of-strength figure (N/3) it would fight at. Evaluated in the func_05CA7E head.
HALF.outputs: Y/N prompt 'these men are tired... they will fight at {N/3 strength}.' Choosing Charge commits the weakened attack (attacker strength is scaled by soft_score/3 in the combat math); choosing rest aborts the attack.

SIEGE.trigger: Player tries to create/train a non-military unit in a colony that is under siege (enemy combat units in the surrounding area outnumber friendly combat units).
SIEGE.inputs: Colony's surrounding-area combat-unit balance (enemy vs friendly). Gated in the colony-management overlay func_02883E.
SIEGE.outputs: Refusal message: while besieged, only Soldier and Dragoon units may be created in this colony. Shows the SIEGE notice; no unit is created.

COUNTRIES.trigger: Filler/lookup table of non-playable nation names used when a message needs to name a foreign (king's-enemy) country, e.g. for KINGNEWWAR / war-declaration text.
COUNTRIES.inputs: An index selecting one of the listed countries; pulled by the king/war message builders (func_033F6A area).
COUNTRIES.outputs: Supplies one country name from the fixed list: the Holy Roman Empire, the Portuguese, the Ottoman Turks, the Barbary Pirates, Russia, Prussia, Sweden, Denmark. Not an event in itself; substituted into combat/war narration.

AMBUSHHINT.trigger: Per-power liberty-bell tick (func_03C322 = ff_bells_tick): during the revolution phase, the first time a power's accumulated bells cross the Continental-Congress threshold (game-phase bit0 set, bits1-2 clear, bells_toward_next > bells produced this turn), the 'Congress newly available' notification fires, printing the AMBUSHHINT combat-tip dialog (immediately followed by CONSIDER).
AMBUSHHINT.inputs: PowerRecord bells-toward-next-Father pool vs bells produced this turn; the game-phase flags (revolution-active bit, Congress-unlocked latch bits); bell threshold from ff_bells_required.
AMBUSHHINT.outputs: Hint dialog: when your troops attack the King's troops while NEITHER unit is in a colony square, you gain an ambush bonus equal to the terrain's normal defensive value. Sets game-phase bit2 (notified latch). Note: this is a tutorial/strategy tip, not a combat resolution.

SHIPCOMBAT.trigger: Player orders a non-warship (or any ship that is not a Privateer/Frigate) to attack an enemy ship, or a ship move resolves to the 'cannot attack ships' status. Dispatched in the ship move/arrival handler func_03FDDE (destination status case 7).
SHIPCOMBAT.inputs: Active ship's type; destination classified by func_03FA9C which writes the ship-dest status code.
SHIPCOMBAT.outputs: Refusal message: 'Only Privateers and Frigates can attack enemy ships.'. The attack is not performed.

GIVECASH.trigger: A weak/helpless settlement (native village or other) offers a cash bribe to a stronger attacker to be spared, just before an attack would resolve. Surfaced in the European/native diplomacy meeting dispatcher func_057F4E (paid-peace MEEK/GIVECASH branch).
GIVECASH.inputs: Defender's available gold (the offered amount, computed from the other power's gold scaled by a difficulty/strength factor x100); whether the parties are not already at war.
GIVECASH.outputs: Y/N dialog offering N gold for peace/sparing. Accepting transfers N gold from the defender to the player and sets a peace/treaty bit; declining proceeds with the attack.

PIRACY.trigger: Another European power (or the King) demands you withdraw your Privateers that are lurking off their coast, during a diplomacy parley. War-grievance exchange in func_057F4E (gated on a contact bit and the offended power having a colony/strength).
PIRACY.inputs: Presence of your Privateers near the complaining power's coast; the request/demand verb (MEEKNESS) chosen by their attitude.
PIRACY.outputs: Dialog demanding withdrawal of all Privateers. Choosing to comply withdraws them to Europe and clears the war high-bit; denying piracy keeps them and risks war.

SIEGES.trigger: Another power demands you withdraw the large military force you have stationed adjacent to their colonies, during a diplomacy parley (SIEGES exchange in func_057F4E).
SIEGES.inputs: Count of your military units adjacent to the complaining power's colonies vs their tolerance threshold; the request/demand verb.
SIEGES.outputs: Dialog demanding withdrawal of all units adjacent to their colonies. Complying withdraws your forces to Europe; refusing keeps them (and lowers their attitude / risks war).

NOPLOW.trigger: Player orders a Pioneer to plow a tile that has already been plowed.
NOPLOW.inputs: Target tile's plowed flag. Checked in the pioneer-order overlay func_02211E.
NOPLOW.outputs: Refusal: 'That land has already been plowed.'. No action, no tools consumed.

NOROAD.trigger: Player orders a Pioneer to build a road on a tile that already has a road.
NOROAD.inputs: Target tile's road flag. Checked in the pioneer-order overlay func_022334.
NOROAD.outputs: Refusal: 'There is already a road here, Your Excellency.'. No action, no tools consumed.

LOBOTOMIZE.trigger: Player chooses to clear a colonist's specialty (the 'Clear Specialty' job), turning a specialist back into an ordinary Free Colonist.
LOBOTOMIZE.inputs: Selected colonist's current specialty profession. Handled in func_028D8C.
LOBOTOMIZE.outputs: Y/N confirmation: clear this colonist's specialty ({profession}) and make him an ordinary free colonist? On Yes, the unit's profession is reset to Free Colonist.

UNITOPTIONS.trigger: Player clicks a land unit in a colony to open its per-unit action menu.
UNITOPTIONS.inputs: Selected unit. Menu built in the unit-options overlay func_02B046.
UNITOPTIONS.outputs: Action menu listing: Move to front / Clear orders / Sentry-or-Board ship / Fortify / No changes (string handle for UNITOPTIONS). Choosing an item sets the unit's orders accordingly.

NOMOREWAGONS.trigger: Player sets a colony to build a Wagon Train when the player already has as many wagon trains as colonies (the wagon-train cap = colony count).
NOMOREWAGONS.inputs: Current wagon-train count vs colony count. Checked in the build-selection overlay func_02D0E4.
NOMOREWAGONS.outputs: Refusal: 'X is set to produce a Wagon Train, but we are not allowed to have more wagon trains than we have colonies ({N}).'. Build order rejected.

NEWCOLONIST.trigger: A colony's accumulated food crosses the population-growth threshold during the colony turn update, producing a new colonist.
NEWCOLONIST.inputs: Colony food stockpile / growth counter. Emitted by the colony turn-update path func_02D658.
NEWCOLONIST.outputs: A new Free Colonist becomes available in the colony (placed on the 'fence'). Shows 'Population increase in X. New colonist now available.'.

USEDUPTOOLS.trigger: A Pioneer (or Hardy Pioneer) consumes the last of its tools while terraforming and reverts to a plain colonist.
USEDUPTOOLS.inputs: Pioneer's remaining tool count reaching zero. Handled in the unit/terraform overlay func_040608.
USEDUPTOOLS.outputs: The pioneer is converted back to Free Colonist (Hardy Pioneer keeps its expert class). Shows 'Our pioneer has reverted to colonist status after using all its tools.'.

CLEARCUT.trigger: A Pioneer finishes clearing a forest tile that is adjacent to one of your colonies; the felled timber is added to that colony's lumber stockpile.
CLEARCUT.inputs: The cleared forest tile; nearest owning colony; lumber yield N from the clear. Handled in the clear-forest overlay func_040656.
CLEARCUT.outputs: Forest is removed and {N lumber} is added to the colony stockpile. Shows 'Pioneers clear forest near X. {N lumber} added to stockpile.'.

GRUDGEWAGONS.trigger: Your wagon train arrives to trade at a native settlement of a tribe that is angry at you (you have committed atrocities), but the tribe grudgingly trades anyway.
GRUDGEWAGONS.inputs: Tribe's attitude toward you / atrocity record; arriving wagon train. Handled in func_04A37C (wagon-train-at-settlement outcome, sibling of the haggle resolver).
GRUDGEWAGONS.outputs: Trade proceeds: 'We grudgingly receive your wagons in spite of the atrocities you have committed against the X people.'.

KILLWAGONS.trigger: Your wagon train enters the territory of a tribe hostile enough that it is destroyed/disappears (the worst wagon-at-settlement outcome).
KILLWAGONS.inputs: Tribe attitude/hostility; arriving wagon train. Handled in func_04A37C.
KILLWAGONS.outputs: The wagon train is lost. Shows 'Our wagon train has disappeared without a trace in X country.'.

MADATWAGONS.trigger: Your wagon train tries to trade at a native settlement of a tribe that, due to your atrocities, refuses to trade with you.
MADATWAGONS.inputs: Tribe attitude/atrocity record; arriving wagon train. Handled in func_04A37C.
MADATWAGONS.outputs: Trade refused: 'Because of the atrocities you have committed against the X people, we do not wish to trade with you.'.

MAYBEWITHDRAW.trigger: During a parley, when another power demands you withdraw forces near their colonies, this is the counter-offer where they agree to move THEIR forces in exchange for a demobilization payment. Surfaced in the diplomacy WITHDRAW negotiation block of func_057F4E.
MAYBEWITHDRAW.inputs: The demobilization fee N (cost-to-move). Player's gold for the alternate 'pay' choice.
MAYBEWITHDRAW.outputs: Dialog: 'Our forces protect valid interests. We are willing to move them in exchange for {N} to cover demobilization.' Options: pay N (gold transferred, forces withdraw), threaten ('withdraw or perish'), or never mind.

NOTWITHDRAW.trigger: During a parley, the other power flatly refuses to withdraw their forces near your colonies (the hard-no response to a withdraw request). Diplomacy WITHDRAW block of func_057F4E.
NOTWITHDRAW.inputs: The other power's resolve (attitude/strength). Their forces remain in place.
NOTWITHDRAW.outputs: 'Our forces protect valid X interests and shall not be moved.'. No withdrawal occurs.

LOSTOURSCOUTS.trigger: Your Scout attempts to infiltrate a foreign colony and fails, getting captured by the colony's owner.
LOSTOURSCOUTS.inputs: Scout unit and the target colony's owning power; the infiltration outcome (data-resident odds). Resolved in the scout-action path func_059B90.
LOSTOURSCOUTS.outputs: Your scout party is lost (captured). Shows 'Our scouts near X have been captured by the Y, Your Excellency!'.

LOSTTHEIRSCOUTS.trigger: An enemy power's Scout attempts to infiltrate one of YOUR colonies and is caught.
LOSTTHEIRSCOUTS.inputs: Enemy scout; your colony; the scout's horse count N. Resolved in the scout-action path func_059B90.
LOSTTHEIRSCOUTS.outputs: You capture the enemy scout party and add its {N horses} to the colony stables. Shows 'We have captured a party of X scouts attempting to infiltrate Y... Their {N horses} have been taken to the colony stables.'.

VETERAN.trigger: A regular soldier/dragoon survives and 'hardens' into a Veteran after combat (the Veteran-promotion branch of the post-combat FX routine, reached on a combat WIN).
VETERAN.inputs: Winning UnitRecord whose post-combat reclassification hits the Veteran branch. Pre-veteran soldier/dragoon class.
VETERAN.outputs: The unit type advances to Veteran. Shows 'Our X have hardened to Veteran status, Your Excellency!'.

VANISH.trigger: A colony runs completely out of food during the colony turn update and all its colonists starve, eliminating the colony.
VANISH.inputs: Colony food stockpile reaching zero with no production. Detected in the colony turn-update path func_02D658.
VANISH.outputs: The colony is destroyed. Shows 'Our colony at X has vanished! The colonists appear to have starved to death.'.

BADHAGGLE2.trigger: When BUYING a good from a native settlement, the player haggles too aggressively and exhausts the tribe's patience; the natives refuse to sell anything further until the player brings something of value.
BADHAGGLE2.inputs: Haggle-escalation state in the native trade resolver func_049600 (the BUY-side patience-exhausted state); the player's offer history this session.
BADHAGGLE2.outputs: 'Our patience with your haggling is exhausted. We will sell you nothing further until you bring us something of value.'. Sale aborted; the settlement is flagged unwilling to sell.

BADHAGGLE3.trigger: The player re-approaches a native settlement that already refused to sell (BADHAGGLE2 state) and tries to buy again without having brought anything new.
BADHAGGLE3.inputs: The settlement's already-refused sell state; the player's (still empty-handed) approach. Native trade resolver func_049600.
BADHAGGLE3.outputs: 'As we said before, we will sell you nothing further until you bring us something of value.'. No sale.

BUYWHICH.trigger: A scout/wagon arrives at a native settlement willing to sell, and the game presents the menu of goods the tribe has available to buy.
BUYWHICH.inputs: The three commodities the settlement currently offers for sale (data-driven by the settlement). Native trade resolver func_049600.
BUYWHICH.outputs: Menu: 'We have {A}, {B}, and {C} available to trade with you. Which would you like to buy?' with the three goods plus 'Nothing'. Selecting one proceeds to the BUY0/BUY1 price-haggle dialog.

WELLSEASONED.trigger: A Scout improves from base to Seasoned status (a scout-specific promotion, emitted from the native-village / exploration interaction path).
WELLSEASONED.inputs: Scout unit; the seasoning-promotion condition (e.g. successful exploration / chief interaction). Emitted in func_04A7CA (chief/village interaction).
WELLSEASONED.outputs: The scout's class advances to Seasoned. Shows 'Our Scouts have improved to Seasoned status, Your Excellency.'.

NOTHINGWITHDRAW.trigger: During a parley you ask another power to withdraw their forces from near your colonies, but they have no forces adjacent to your colonies. Diplomacy WITHDRAW block of func_057F4E.
NOTHINGWITHDRAW.inputs: Count of the other power's units adjacent to your colonies == 0.
NOTHINGWITHDRAW.outputs: 'We have no forces adjacent to your colonies.'. No action.

CASHTREASURE.trigger: A Treasure unit is sold to foreign agents (cashed in without shipping it home via a galleon), or, in the demo/endgame fast path, treasure is auto-converted; resolved in the treasure-transport event func_05C878.
CASHTREASURE.inputs: Treasure base value = 100 x settlement size; a tax/share multiplier M (capped at 90; for the non-pirate case M = max((player_difficulty+10)*5, pool*2)); gold_delta = M * base / 100. Attacker PowerRecord.
CASHTREASURE.outputs: Treasure is sold for N gold, credited to the power's treasury; the remaining (base - gold_delta) accrues to total-loot and score-bonus. Shows 'Treasure sold to foreign agents for {N}.'.

ORE.trigger: During the colony turn update, the colony's ore stockpile is exhausted (ore over-production counter set this turn) while no consuming chain is present (blacksmiths can't get ore), so the 'out of ore' production report fires. Phase 8 of func_02D658.
ORE.inputs: Colony ore over-production counter set this turn plus a 'no blacksmith chain present' test; emitted in func_02D658 Phase 8.
ORE.outputs: Production warning: 'X has run out of ore, Your Excellency. Our blacksmiths cannot continue their work until a new supply is found.'. (Note: this is a colony production report, not a Founding-Father event despite the worklist grouping.)

TOOLS.trigger: During the colony turn update, the colony's tools stockpile is exhausted (tools over-production counter set) while no consuming chain is present (gunsmiths can't get tools). Phase 8 of func_02D658.
TOOLS.inputs: Colony tools over-production counter set this turn plus a 'no gunsmith chain present' test; emitted in func_02D658 Phase 8.
TOOLS.outputs: Production warning: 'X has run out of tools, Your Excellency. Our gunsmiths cannot continue their work until a new supply is found.'. (Colony production report, not a Founding-Father event.)

HELLOUSA.trigger: You begin a diplomacy parley with another European power that has WON its independence and become a 'United States'-style republic; the post-independence greeting variant is selected. Greeting block of the European-diplomacy meeting dispatcher func_057F4E.
HELLOUSA.inputs: The other power's post-revolution (independent) state; greeting-variant selector (chooses HELLOUSA over HELLOFIRST/HELLOAHOY/HELLOMEEK/HELLOMANLY).
HELLOUSA.outputs: Greeting line: 'Greetings, X, from the newly elected government of the {Y}.'. Opens the parley.
